profile.overview: Prismari College is a blue-red college associated with Arcavios / Strixhaven.
profile.philosophy: Magic and art are the same act when craft, emotion, spectacle, and elemental force become expression.
profile.core_tension: Prismari splits between disciplined technique and raw expression, blue refinement and red catharsis.
profile.social_or_institutional_role: The official guides frame Prismari as the College of Elemental Arts, whose students make magic through performance and elemental media.
profile.mechanics_and_play_pattern: Prismari's mechanical and thematic identity centers on spells, elemental scale, performance, and expressive payoff.
profile.placement_use: Use this profile to support thematic placement, quiz design, and lore browsing. Do not present placement inferences as canon.
